final_hook: Centralized systems leave your capital vulnerable. Vanna offers verifiable control.
body:
[Day 1 · Twitter, Reddit · Awareness]

Don't let centralized systems or opaque protocols put your capital at risk. Regulatory shifts can freeze funds, creating unforeseen vulnerabilities. Vanna offers verifiable, infrastructure-led control, designed for resilience against evolving compliance. Experience true capital security on our testnet. #VannaTestnet #CapitalControl

CTA: Learn how Vanna secures your capital.
Incentive: Implied benefit of enhanced security and control.
KPI: Click-through rate (CTR) on posts, initial Galxe quest page views.
